tools.name: verify_receipt
tools.description: Verify an AgentToll receipt against live Solana state: PDA owner must be the AgentToll program and the stored digest must match the receipt. Look up by receipt_id, or by x402_payment_ref (always works — the receipt lives on-chain). Read-only, no cost.

tools.name: get_receipt
tools.description: Fetch full receipt details: digests, checks, outcome, amount, buyer, seller, timestamp, PDA. Look up by receipt_id, or by x402_payment_ref (always works — the receipt lives on-chain). Read-only, no cost.
